entities.name: Fatima
entities.description: Planeswalker princess of Rabiah who created the City of Brass and the first Brass Man.

entities.name: al-Abin
entities.description: Fatima's lover who asked her hand after agreeing never to marry her.

entities.name: City of Brass
entities.description: City Fatima created, blazing with the heat of her fury.

entities.name: Brass Men
entities.description: Creatures Fatima created in her city.

events.summary: Al-Abin changes his mind and asks Fatima's hand; furious, she rages for days.
events.quote: Furious at al-Abin and his land, Fatima went into a rage that lasted several days.

events.summary: Fatima creates the City of Brass.
events.quote: Fatima created the City of Brass

events.summary: Fatima's power grows until she can planeswalk; she moves the city to the edge of Rabiah and creates the first Brass Man.

relations.quote: Fatima created the City of Brass

relations.note: First Brass Man out of loneliness
